photos.name: both-loaves-side-by-side
photos.summary: Both sourdough boules on wire racks after baking — loaf 1 (left) shows deeper golden color from 480°F/450°F bake, loaf 2 (right) paler from lower uncovered temp at 425°F.

photos.name: bread-lame-razor-blade
photos.summary: Bread lame with single-edge razor blade mounted — frustration with the tool's awkward angle and shallow scoring depth on cross patterns.

photos.name: loaf1-blistered-crust-detail
photos.summary: Close-up of loaf 1 crust showing pronounced blistering and textured surface — deep golden color from 480°F covered bake, cross score bloom visible.

photos.name: loaf1-cooling-rack-cross-score
photos.summary: Loaf 1 on wire cooling rack after baking — cross score pattern opened well during oven spring, banneton ring pattern visible on sides, blistered crust texture.

photos.name: loaf1-held-up-profile
photos.summary: Profile view of loaf 1 held on wire rack — showing good dome height and cross score pattern, blistered crust texture from high-heat covered bake.
